title: Create one bounded repository file
userIntent: Create one explicitly allowed evaluation file through the public safe-patch surface and change nothing else.

intendedBehavior: The safe patch creates exactly one allowed file.
behavioralInvariants: Only the isolated sandbox changes; source remains unchanged.
regressionRisks: The mutation escapes allowed paths or fails to record the created file.

provenance.note: Shared behavior anchored to the exact Forge v1.7.2 release commit.
